title: Grateful Dead Live at Strand Lyceum on 1972-05-23

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with some hiss, yet tight playing and great tone make for a killer performance.
ai_review.review: The fan notes a fair amount of hiss in the soundboard capture but praises the band’s tight playing and overall great tone, especially for a 1972 show. While the audio isn’t pristine, the musical execution shines through, delivering an enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it gives a 4‑star rating and mentions both modest recording noise and strong performance, leading to an overall good but not exceptional score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fair amount of hiss present; otherwise clear tone and decent balance for a 1972 soundboard source.
